TCD.note: The National Data Center is described as state infrastructure; the document does not say it rents space, power or computing to others.
No rule that data must be kept in the country is stated.

facts.fact: Ecofin reports Chadian authorities say the PMICE forms part of a broader digital sovereignty strategy, with state control over fibre-optic networks and data storage capacity as a key lever, and that Phase I, including a National Data Center, was provisionally accepted on 2025-12-20.
Ecofin reports the Chadian ministry said a 1,200 km national fibre-optic backbone, part of PMICE Phase I, was provisionally accepted at Sarh on 2025-12-20 and is now considered operational.

TCD.note: The document states nothing on international fibre routes.
No share of the population using the internet is stated.
The document does not say the National Data Center is for hire, its tier, or that state data is hosted in it.
The document states nothing on satellite broadband.
